added_examples.translation: Denn, wenn sie1inmal die steuern verweigern, so kann niemand gehen und sie von ihnen eintreiben, wenn nicht Kara Tadschdin geht und sie erhebt. Von uns kann niemand gehen.

summary: Proposed new entry tḥṣl. Only mtaḥṣele in an Infectum context is attested; no Preterit, Imperativ, Infinitiv, Detransitive or reconstructed paradigm is supplied.
If t is part of a four-consonant root tḥṣl, the glossary stem label is Q. The reader's I label is corrected provisionally; derivation from ḥṣl remains an open alternative.

Read-only lookups: ḥṣl has existence/obtaining; ḥyṣl has getting hold of or catching, despite a head etymology mentioning Arabic fiscal senses. Neither supplies the t-form or this tax construction. The form lookup lists consonantal candidates, not a lexical match.
A contact formation related to Arabic taḥṣīl is plausible from the reader's observation, but not independently established. The token is a single verb, not a light-verb-plus-noun construction.
Actor Qara Taždin is discourse-shared with əzze; -e is interpreted as tax object. Payors appear with m- in the preceding retrieval clause; do not automatically assign that government to mtaḥṣele.
Confirm whether tḥṣl is an independent quadriliteral Q loan/denominal root or a local derivative of ḥṣl/ḥyṣl.
Confirm segmentation mtaḥṣel-e and elicit secure base forms; the source only attests this suffixed Infectum.
